channel.title: Personal Ledger
channel.description: Updates for Personal Ledger on Windows.

item.title: Version 1.0.5
item.description:
What's new in 1.0.5

  • Personal Ledger opens only once: starting it again while it's open brings the open window to the front.
  • New account types: Owner's capital for your own money in the books, and Suspense for amounts still to sort out.
  • Entries brought in from spreadsheets are marked Imported, keep their rupee amount and rate, and can be edited like your own.
